err_connection_failed_desc: Waawaa jokkondirde e joloowo oo. Yenanee wonde kaɓirgol ngol ina muusi (kuutoro pin ngam toɓɓude butoŋ reset so ina haani), ittu USB, jokkondir kadi so ɗum naamnaama.

err_flash_write_failed_desc: Flashing taƴaama walla golle binndol ɗee ndartaaki. Ƴeewto so tawii kaɓirgal USB ngal ina tiiɗi, tee batte ɗee ina njogii doole keewɗe, ƴeewto kadi.
err_generic_flash_failed_desc: Juumre nde miijaaka waɗii e sahaa udditgol ({detail}). Softin piiloowo oo haa laaɓa, jokkondir so aɗa naamnee, ƴeew kadi.
err_keep_data_failed: Waawaa jogaade dottaaɗe maa e media maa: foldere firmware ndee winndaaka. Alaa ko ligginaa.
err_missing_package_files_desc: Pakket firmware oo ina ŋakki fiilde scatter walla fiilde natal ɗaɓɓaande. Tiiɗno, ƴettu paaspoor oo walla cuɓo-ɗaa fiilde firmware timmunde.
err_mtk_output_stall_desc: Kuutorgal ɓuuɓngal ngal hollitii doggol gootol e nder leƴƴanɗe {seconds} cakkitiiɗe ɗee, tee feeñataa ina jokki winndude firmware oo. Ina gasa tawa flash oo ina ŋakki. err_mtk_output_stall_fallback_available: Oo ordinateer ina waawi kadi udditde huutoraade SP Flash Tool. So aɗa waawi, waylu e SP Flash Tool, ƴeewto-ɗaa kadi.
err_mtk_output_stall_title: Flash oo wayi ko no ɓuuɓɗo nii

err_sp_brom_da_fail: Waɗde, ƴettugol ngol waawaano neldeede e joloowo oo. Doole mum, jokkondir kadi.
err_sp_brom_startcmd: Fiyoowo oo doole mum ko yaawi. Doole mum timma, caggal ɗuum jokkondira e mum kadi.

err_sp_da_init_sync: Wakiilo ƴettugol ngol waawaano fuɗɗaade. Enndu feere flash woɗnde ndee.
err_sp_da_invalid_type: Pijirlooji ɗii njaɓaani golloowo ƴettugol (juumre 6104). Huutoro Agent Download jokkondirɗo e kuutorgal SP Flash, ƴeewto so tawii firmware oo ina yahdi e ooɗoo pijirlooji.
err_sp_download_fail: Binndol ngol taƴaa. Ƴeewto kaɓirgal USB e porto e charge batte, caggal ɗuum ƴeewto.
err_sp_enable_dram: Kuutorgal ngal waawaano fuɗɗoraade ciimtol joloowo oo. Huutoro paaspoor mahaaɗo ooɗoo model tigi-rigi.

rockbox_step2_connect_usb: Eɗen ñaagii nde njokkondirta e {model} maa e USB

rockbox_themes_notice_body: Rockbox on Y1 no longer supports iPod classic (240p) themes from Rockbox.org. You'll have to use 360p Rockbox themes made for Y1. Click next to continue.
rockbox_troubleshoot_desc: So {model} maa ɓuuɓnaaki, taƴtu USB, jogo butoŋ doole fotde 10s ngam reset, e doole on. Walla artirde lowre asliire.
rockbox_wizard_adb_desc: App oo ina ndaara jokkondiral ADB (fotde leƴƴanɗe 30). So kaɓirgal tawaama, tiitooɗe ɗee mbaylitee, pijirlooji ɗii puɗɗotoo ko otomatik. So wonaa ɗuum, ƴeeŋtu yeeso e Mode Storage USB.
rockbox_wizard_adb_push_failed: Jaltugol ADB ngol ŋakki; fawaade e Mode Deftordu USB
rockbox_wizard_adb_pushing: Puɗɗagol tiitooɗe e binndi dow ADB...
rockbox_wizard_adb_timeout: Alaa kaɓirgal ADB yiytaa e nder leƴƴanɗe 30 ; jokkude e Mode Restoraaji USB.
rockbox_wizard_done_desc: Jooni aɗa waawi seerndude pijirlooji ɗii e kisal, cuɓo-ɗaa tiitoonde e nder Rockbox (Cuɓe > Cuɓe Tiitoonde).
rockbox_wizard_no_adb: Alaa binndol ADB ina woodi e app oo; jokkude e Mode Restoraaji USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc:
1. Sokkitde kaɓirgal USB ngal.
2. Doole joloowo oo artira e mum, ɗaccu ɗum boot e nder Rockbox.
3. So Rockbox ina doga, jokkondir e kaɓirgal USB ngal, caggal ɗuum toɓɓu Continue.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_power: Hoɗdu e butoŋ doole ngam ustude piiloowo maa, jokkondir USB, cuɓo-ɗaa Mode Storage USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_desc_y1: Hoɗdu butoŋ hakkundeejo ngam huɓɓude Y1 maa, jokkondir USB, cuɓo-ɗaa Mode Storage USB.
rockbox_wizard_reboot_title: Ɗatal 1: Fuɗɗoode joloowo oo e jokkondirde
rockbox_wizard_usb_desc:
1. Softinde Mode Storage USB e dow joloowo oo mbele ina feeña no diski nii.
2. Suɓo KALA foldere e nder pijirlooji les ɗii (.rockbox, Miijo, Teemaaji, walla root diski, foldere .rockbox suuɗnde ina tawee e hoore mum).
3. App oo ina hawra e tiitooɗe 360p e binndi e nder, ina winnda e dow fiiluuji innde wootere.

rockbox_y1_theme_warning_prompt: Rockbox e Y1 nattii wallitde tiitooɗe iPod ɓooyɗe (240p) ummoraade e Rockbox.org - aɗa foti huutoraade tiitooɗe Rockbox 360p peewnaaɗe ngam Y1 - ɓuɗɗu e sara ngam jokkude

sel_multiple_scatters_error: Paaspooruuji firmware keewɗi walla piille scatter tawaama e ndeeɗoo foldere/arsiif. Tiiɗno, suɓo foldere walla arsiif tawa ina waɗi paaspoor firmware gooto tan e sahaa gooto.
sel_multiple_scatters_release_error: Ndee yaltinnde ina waɗi ko ɓuri fiilde scatter wootere, ko ɗum waɗi Updater waawaa anndude hol laylaytol ngol pijirlooji maa njiɗi. Sifaa {software} ina foti hesɗitinde yaltinɗe firmware mum en ngam waɗde tan ko fiilde scatter wootere.
sel_no_release: Alaa ko yaltinaa e ooɗoo lowre
sel_notes_hint: Suɓo yaltinnde ngam yiyde mbayliigu mum
sel_offline: Limtooji e internet ɗii ngalaa jooni. Huutoro fiilde nokkuure, walla ƴeewto jokkorde maa.
sel_offline_install: Sosde lowre ummoraade e fiilngo .zip walla .rar e kala jokkorgal Innioasis walla Timmkoo.
sel_offline_install_generic: Sosde lowre ummoraade e defterdu .zip/.rar walla doggol lowre e kaɓirɗe MediaTek generik.
sel_only_local: Suɓo .zip walla .rar nokkuure, walla fiilde .txt foldere / scatter, ngam udditde tawa aɗa woni e laylaytol, alaa ko internet haani. Ina golloo e kala piiloowo Innioasis e Timmkoo.
sel_only_local_generic: Suɓo paaspoor firmware nokkuure (.zip, .rar) walla foldere jogiinde fiilngo scatter ngam udditde tawa ko e laylaytol, ina golloroo e kaɓirɗe MediaTek generik.
sel_prompt_need_firmware: Suɓo .zip, .rar arsiif, walla fiilngo cirƴam (*scatter*.txt) nder doggol lowre ngam sosde lowre cuɓaande maa e {target} maa.
sel_source_desc: Sokkit firmware e internet, walla naatnu paaspoor nokkuure.
sel_themepack_guidance_body:
Tiiɗno, taƴtu USB, huɓɓu e boot e nder Rockbox laawol gootol (hono no ɗum fuɗɗorii foldere mum nder .rockbox system), caggal ɗuum jokkondir USB e suɓaade 'Mode Storage USB'.

So a jokkondirii, ɓuɗɗu e Jokku ngam suɓaade kala foldere e nder pijirlooji maa.

sel_themepack_success: Rockbox Theme Pack ina jokki e udditde e kaɓirgol maa!
sel_type_help_body:
Enndu Software Siistem Type A ko adii.

So tawii jolngo maa jaabaaki caggal nde jolnaa, jolnu heen gooto e cuɓe Tipe B.

Kaɓirɗe mbaydi B ko ɗe ngardi e mbaydiiji firmware ko adii 2.0.

settings_240p_tip: Hollitta ko mahdiiji ɗi zip ROM mum en woni 240p (rom..._240p.zip). Mahdiiji 240p njahdaani e yuɓɓooji Y1 e Innioasis OS les 3.0.7, ko ɗum waɗi Hollit Mahdiiji Rockbox ɓooyɗi ina softina ɗum.
settings_add_device_no_versions: Alaa mbaydiiji gonɗi e ooɗoo lowre jooni.
settings_add_device_type_hint: Type ko ƴeewndo hardware joloowo. Pijirlooji e mbaadi ngootiri ina mbaawi mahde e ko ɓuri rewindaade gooto — yeru Type A e Type B — e lowre ina waɗee ngam gooto e maɓɓe. Ƴeewto sticker mo woni e ɓalewol joloowo oo; so tawii nde inniraani sifaa, accu suɓngo adanngo ngoo.
settings_advanced_desc: Hollitta ko feere udditgol, mbaadi udditgol e filtoraaji yaltinɗi.
settings_allow_keep_data_any: Jaɓ Jogaade Cuɓe e Media e kala jolngo firmware
settings_allow_keep_data_any_desc: Skips naamnal jokkondire. Huutoro ɗum tan so aɗa sikki piiloowo oo maa jokku golle e dottaaɗe mum jooni ɗee e mediaaji mum.
settings_arm64_driver_note: Ballal Windows ARM64 ƴeewtaaka. E nder portaabe Snapdragon e RTX Spark, Zadig ina waawi huutoreede tawa Dowlaaji Dentuɗi ina ngoɗɗi ngam sosde WinUSB walla libusb ngam kaɓirgol MT6227 Preloader e nder Dowlaaji Dentuɗi. Ƴeew doggol difooje ARM64 ngam humpitaade laabi ɗii.
settings_cache_desc: Mumtu paaspooruuji firmware ƴettaaɗi e piille ROM ƴettaaɗe ngam ustude nokku disko. Daartol udditgol maa e ɓuranɗe ciftorgol kesɗitingol ina ndesndaa.
settings_checker_desc: Heɓta ordinateer maa ngam jokkondirde e joloowo maa e udditde keso lowre ndee e dow nuunɗal.
settings_checker_desc_advanced: Ƴeewto njuɓɓudi Linux yahrude yeeso ngam SP Flash Tool, jokkondire USB, yamiroore serial, e geɗe njuɓɓudi.
settings_checker_desc_friendly: Heɓta ordinateer maa ngam jokkondirde e joloowo maa e udditde keso lowre ndee e dow nuunɗal.
settings_checker_desc_installer: Heɓta ordinateer maa ngam jokkondirde e joloowo maa ngam hesɗitinde lowre.
settings_donations_dismiss: Hoto meeɗ hollude mi ɗum kadi
settings_driver_desc: Ko adii nde kuutorto-ɗaa app oo ko adii, aɗa foti waɗde heen diisnondiroowo USB MediaTek, caggal ɗuum uddit ordinateer maa.
settings_drivers_gate_body: Sosde difooje USB MediaTek ko huunde wootere, Windows ina ƴetta ɗe tan caggal nde ɗe puɗɗii. Haa ɗiɗo fof mbaɗa, app oo ina waawi yiytude joloowo maa so install fuɗɗiima.
settings_drivers_gate_title: Ko adii nde aɗa ɓeyda heen joloowo
settings_filter_original_pre307: Hollit yaltinɗe Software asliije ɓurɗe ɓooyde e 3.0.7
settings_firmware_up_to_date: Kaɓirɗe rewindaaɗe ɗee kala ina kuutoroo yaltooje firmware cakkitiiɗe ɗee!
settings_guided_install: Ardin am e nder install e nder app
settings_guided_install_desc: App oo ina heddii e maa rewrude e mumtugol, jokkondirde, e udditde.
settings_hide_donations_tip: Mumtu ngam suuɗde njeenaari e ɗaɓɓaande dokke ngam ƴeewde laaɓal.
settings_install_themes_desc: So ɗum softinaama, tiitooɗe Rockbox ina njuutee e Y1 caggal nde Rockbox jolnaa no moƴƴi.
settings_no_devices_tracked: Alaa jolngo kaɓirɗe winndaa tawo. Flash kaɓirgal ngam waawde rewindaade mbaydi.

settings_old_rockbox_warn_body:
Yarlitiiɓe Rockbox-Y1 ko adii 0.5 njahdaani e yuɓɓooji Y1 yeeyeteeɗi caggal lewru marse 2026 tawa Innioasis OS 3.0.7 ina joɗɗinaa ko adii.

Flashing build ɓooyɗo e ɗeen kaɓirɗe maa haɗ booting.

Aɗa sikki aɗa yiɗi hollirde mahdiiji Rockbox ɓooyɗi?
settings_original_pre307_warn_body:
Software asliijo yaltinaaɗo ɓurɗo ɓooyde e 3.0.7 yahdaani e yuɓɓooji Y1 yeeyeteeɗi e Innioasis OS 3.0.7. Flashing build ɓooyɗo e ɗeen yuɓɓooji maa haɗ ɗe udditde haa nde mbaydi kesiri ndii artiraa.

Aɗa sikki aɗa yiɗi hollirde yaltinɗe Software Asliije ɓurɗe ɓooyde e 3.0.7?

settings_rockbox_desc: Huutortee ko nde njiyloto-ɗaa yaltinɗe lowre.
settings_run_as_admin_desc: Naamndo Windows hakkeeji njuɓɓudi so install fuɗɗiima. SP Flash Tool e MTKClient ndeen ina ndoga e jokkondire timmuɗe, laawol ƴeewndo caɗeele so difoore walla porto saliima udditaade.
settings_run_as_admin_restart_needed: Hesɗitinoowo ina foti fuɗɗoraade ngam installuuji ɗii mbaawa dogaade e ɗeen hakkeeji.
settings_run_as_admin_unavailable: Ooɗoo desktop alaa balloowo toowɗo mo woodi.
settings_run_as_superuser_desc: Doggo installs e hakkeeji root rewrude e pkexec. Huutoro ɗum so boowal yamiroore haɗii kuutorgal flash.
settings_run_in_background_desc: Accu app oo e nder barme menyu walla e nder laylaytol system caggal nde windo ngoo udditaa, mbele aɗa heɓa haa jooni humpitooji kesɗitingol firmware app e player. Off: uddude windo ina yalta app oo.
settings_run_in_background_desc_menu_bar: Waɗtu app oo e nder doggol menyu caggal nde windo ngoo udditaa, mbele aɗa heɓa haa jooni humpitooji kesɗitingol firmware app e player. Off: uddude windo ina yalta app oo.
settings_run_in_background_desc_system_t: Siftor app oo e nder laylaytol system caggal nde windo ngoo udditaa, mbele aɗa heɓa haa jooni humpitooji kesɗitingol firmware app e player. Off: uddude windo ina yalta app oo.
settings_skip_install_donations_tip: Hollit detaayuuji timmuɗi koyɗi tawa ɗaɓɓaani dokke caggal nde njiyloto-ɗaa.
settings_sp_auth_desc: Ha ngiɗa. Won e paandaale MediaTek ina caloo ɓuuɓde haa SP Flash Tool rokka fiilngo hoolkiso (.auth); ɓeydu ɗoo maa so tawii kaɓirgal ngal ina haani.
settings_sp_gui_desc: Uddit Updater e uddita SP Flash Tool GUI e fiilde cirƴam firmware cuɓaande e natal peccitagol ngol ko adii.
settings_sp_gui_install: Waɗde e nder GUI kuutorgal SP Flash
settings_terminal_desc: Doggol lowre maa e nder Terminal ngam yiyde kabaruuji karallaagal e yahrude yeeso.
settings_terminal_desc_windows: Doggo jolngo lowre maa e nder Command Prompt ngam yiyde kabaruuji karallaagal e yahrude yeeso.
settings_themes_refresh_failed: Waawaa hesɗitinde; tiitooɗe mooftaaɗe ɗee ina ngoodi haa jooni.
settings_track_multiple_desc: Keeps a record of every release installed on the same model. With more than one on record the app cannot tell your players apart, so an install asks which software is running and whether to keep your settings and media. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
settings_track_multiple_toggle: Remind me about multiple releases on a single model
settings_track_multiple_warn_body: With more than one release tracked for a model, every install for that model asks which software is on the player and whether to keep your settings and media, because the app cannot tell one player from another. Player update reminders keep working as usual.
simulated_mac_body: MTKClient wonta tan ko feere udditgol e ƴaañorgal keertiingal macOS kollitee. Hesɗitinoowo ina foti fuɗɗoraade ngam huutoraade ɗum.
simulated_mac_body_mediatek: MTKClient wonta tan ko feere udditgol e ƴaañorgal keertiingal macOS kollitee. Installer MediaTek ina foti fuɗɗoraade ngam huutoraade ɗum.
single_instance_body: Koppi goɗɗo ina udditii, walla ina doga haa jooni e nder laabi. Koppiiji ɗiɗi maa ndarto ngam jokkondirde e USB pijirlooji ɗii, ko ɗum waɗi oo fuɗɗotoo.
single_instance_busy_body: Koppi dogdu nduu ko udditde lowre walla haaldude e joloowo, ko ɗum waɗi joofnude ɗum jooni ina taƴa ɗuum. Ngolɗoo udditgol maa udde; huutoro windo gonngo ngoo walla nate mum menyu so install oo gasii.
single_instance_focus_failed: Koppi dogdu nduu jaabaaki ɗaɓɓaande hollirde windo mum. Ina waawi wonde busy walla hung. Doole woppude ɗum maa taƴ kala ko ina liggina.
single_instance_force_failed: Koppi dogdu nduu waawaano joofde. Woppu ɗum e hoore maa, caggal ɗuum fuɗɗoo kesɗitingol ngol kadi.
single_instance_open_anyway: Uddit App Ko waawi heen wonde fof
sp_auth_missing_file: Fiilde hoolkiso yiytaaka ({path}); ɓuuɓde tawa alaa heen.
sp_config_missing_platform: Fiilde scatter ndee bayyinaani platform mum, ko ɗum waɗi konfiguraasiyoŋ konsol ngam fiilde hoolkiso ndee waawaano mahde ; ɓuuɓde tawa alaa heen.
sp_config_missing_storage: Fiilde scatter ndee bayyinaani sifaa mooftirgel (EMMC/NAND/UFS), ko ɗum waɗi konfiguraasiyoŋ konsol ngam fiilde hoolkiso ndee waawaano mahde ; ɓuuɓde tawa alaa heen.
sp_config_no_auth_file: Alaa fiilngo hoolkiso rokkaama; ɓuuɓde tawa alaa heen.

support_methods_subtitle: Suɓo feere darnde ɓurnde welde. Kala dokkal ngal ina yoɓa ƴettugol, jaɓɓaade, e jarribaade kaɓirɗe.
support_story_1_body: Innioasis ina heewi yaltinde firmwareeji kesi ngam fiyooɓe hono Y1 (targeting rewindaade alluuje cuuɗiiɗe hono 6.0, 7.0, e 8.0) ɓuuɓnooje kaɓirɗe ɓooyɗe e nder deeƴre. Ko ɓuri bonde nii, lowre maɓɓe ina rokka jeertinaango zero e jokkondire zero e firmwares gollotooɗi ɓennuɗi ngam heɓtude ngonka brik. Hesɗitinoowo e eɓɓoore Community Firmware ina ƴetta pecce ɗee : min njuɓɓina kala ROM legacy stock, min hoolkisa otomatikk ƴeewndo hardware maa, min njokka pijirlooji maa ina doga e kisal.
support_story_1_headline: So peewnoowo yahrii yeeso, renndo ngoo ina ƴellitoo.
support_story_1_item_1: Hisnude Fulɓe loppitiiɓe: Ƴeewte kisal ina ɗaɓɓi kesɗitingol kesol meeɗaani brik hardware ɓooyɗo.
support_story_1_item_2: ROMs Stock archived: Koolol timmungol firmwares asliiji usineeji Innioasis momtaa.
support_story_1_item_3: Koolaaɗo kuuɓal: Kuutorɗe ɓuuɓɗe timmuɗe ngam macOS, Linux, e Windows fof.
support_story_1_item_4: Hakkille Hardware : Yiytude alluwal otomatik ngam heɓde sahaa kala paaspoor potɗo.
support_story_1_lead: Reende kaɓirgol maa e jolɗe hardware deƴƴuɗe e waylooji bonɗi.
support_story_2_body: Reende lowre Innioasis laawɗunde ina heewi firtude ko ƴeewde jokkorɗe Google Drive timmuɗe, jokkondire ruulde Baidu maayɗe, e piille zip sirlu ɗe ngalaa kuutorɗe ɓuuɓɗe. Min mahii lowre ƴettugol koolkisaande, nde alaa ko woni e mum so wonaa laaɓal SHA-256 hoolkisaangal, humpitooji kesɗitingol, e jolngooji gonɗi e doggol. Dokke mon ina njokki e jogaade ƴeewndorɗe e hosting baawɗo waɗde ɗum waktuuji 24 e ñalawma, balɗe 365 e hitaande.
support_story_2_headline: Alaa Diskooji Google bonɗi. Alaa teskaade-golle. Firmware golloowo tan.
support_story_2_item_1: CDN Direct High-Speed ​​: Jaawɗo, ƴettugol toowngol tawa alaa keerol ƴettugol walla jokkorɗe maayɗe.
support_story_2_item_2: Hesɗitin Notifications: Heɓ jeertinaango e sahaa nde renndo keso yaltini walla peewnugol ngol yani.
support_story_2_item_3: Installs Guided Ɗatal-Ɗatal: Ɗaɓɓaaɗe yiyteede laaɓtuɗe ina njahda e kala toɓɓugol butoŋ.
support_story_2_item_4: Renndo ɗemɗe keewɗe: Engele, Sinuwaa, Almaañ, Españool, Farayse & Japon.
support_story_2_lead: Jaawgol, hoolkisaangol renndo ngo mbaaw-ɗaa fawaade e mum tigi.
support_story_3_body: Software Stock factory ina ƴakka tan ko lowre maa Y1 walla Y2 waawi waɗde. Renndo men addii Rockbox, njuɓɓudi gollordu keeriindi leefndi, ƴeewndo kodek audiophile, e tiitooɗe kuutorteeɗe e nguurndam. Min cooda mbayliigaaji hardware ɓalliwal e nder poos ngam ƴeewndaade, waylude innde, e hoolkisaade kala install. Wallude Updater ina yoɓa ɗeen kuutorɗe jarribooje e yaawnaade ƴellitgol firmware keeriiɗo.
support_story_3_headline: Udditde mbaawkaaji timmuɗi e joloowo maa Innioasis.
support_story_3_item_1: Rockbox Doggol Gooto: Pijirlooji Audiophile e tiitooɗe kuutorteeɗe joɗɗinaaɗe e nder leƴƴanɗe.
support_story_3_item_2: Firmware renndo: Ɓeydagol batte, UI ɓurɗo laaɓtude, e ballal kodek odio jamaanu.
support_story_3_item_3: Active Hardware Lab: Min jarriboo e kaɓirɗe ɓalliije goonga hade amen yaltinde kala mahdi.
support_story_3_item_4: Zero Bloatware : 100% lowre nde alaa ko yoɓi, nde alaa ko woni e mum so wonaa yeeyirde walla rewindaade.
support_story_3_lead: Addude Rockbox, njuɓɓudi gollordu ɓuuɓndi, e ndimaagu audiophile.
support_story_4_body: So sosiyetee hardware yahrii e gadget mum en garoowo, modeleeji ɓooyɗi ina ngoppitee. Innioasis rokkataa ballal Linux, alaa mbayliigu laaɓtungu, kadi alaa feere weeɓnde ngam heɓtude so install ŋakkii. Updater ina woodi sabu huutortooɓe yarlitiiɓe fotaani werlaade pijirlooji moƴƴi timmuɗi. 100% e darnde renndo ina yahra e jogaade ngal kuutorgal udditiingal wonande kala.
support_story_4_headline: Wallu min waɗde ko Innioasis waɗataa.
support_story_4_item_1: Rescue & Unbrick: Koolkisagol sellingol ina ilna hay so kaɓirɗe njaɓaani bootde.
support_story_4_item_2: Ballal Linux : Ballal timmungal MediaTek ɓuuɓngal e distros Linux.
support_story_4_item_3: Transparent Changelogs: Teskorɗe yaltinɗe laaɓtuɗe ngam anndude tigi ko wayli.
support_story_4_item_4: 100% Kaalis Renndo : Kala kafe ina jogoo arsiif udditirɗo, tawa ina yoɓa yimɓe fof.
support_story_4_lead: Hisnude firmware baawɗo renndo ngam haɗde kaɓirɗe maa yaltude e nokkuuji ɓuuɓɗi.
